package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	backend "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/backend"
	simulation "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/cluster"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/wasi"
	model "go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/model/cluster"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func save(path string, value any) {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(value)
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(path, raw, 0600))
}
func main() {
	var input struct {
		Base     wasi.Request
		Scenario simulation.OperatorScenario
		Output   string
		ExpectedOwners int
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	must(err)
	must(json.Unmarshal(raw, &input))
	must(os.MkdirAll(input.Output, 0700))
	module, err := os.ReadFile(input.Base.ModulePath)
	must(err)
	imports, pages, err := backend.InspectModule(module)
	must(err)
	input.Base.Imports, input.Base.InitialMemoryPages = imports, pages
	spec, provider, err := input.Scenario.Bind(input.Base)
	must(err)
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 3*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	observed, err := model.RunWASM(ctx, spec, input.Scenario.Run, provider)
	must(err)
	payload, err := provider.RetentionPayload(spec, observed.Record)
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(input.Output, "retained.json"), payload.Data, 0600))
	encoded, err := model.EncodeClusterRecord(observed.Record)
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(input.Output, "cluster-record.json"), encoded, 0600))
	if observed.WASM.Inspection == nil || !observed.WASM.Inspection.Complete || len(observed.WASM.Inspection.Boundaries) == 0 {
		panic("nonzero complete inspection inventory required")
	}
	retainedModule := simulation.RetainedModule{SHA256: fmt.Sprintf("sha256:%x", sha256.Sum256(module)), Copy: func(destination string) error { return os.WriteFile(destination, module, 0700) }}
	helper := simulation.InstalledHelper{Path: input.Base.HelperPath, SHA256: input.Base.HelperSHA256, Engine: input.Base.Engine}
	replayDir := filepath.Join(input.Output, "replay")
	must(os.Mkdir(replayDir, 0700))
	replay, err := simulation.ReplayRetained(ctx, payload, retainedModule, replayDir, helper)
	must(err)
	replayRaw, err := model.EncodeClusterRecord(replay.Record)
	must(err)
	if string(encoded) != string(replayRaw) {
		panic("API replay record differs")
	}
	save(filepath.Join(input.Output, "spec.json"), spec)
	save(filepath.Join(input.Output, "base.json"), input.Base)
	selected := map[model.NodeHandle][]model.WASMInspectionBoundary{}
	for _, boundary := range observed.WASM.Inspection.Boundaries {
		selected[boundary.Handle] = append(selected[boundary.Handle], boundary)
	}
	if len(selected) != input.ExpectedOwners {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("inspected owners: got %d want %d", len(selected), input.ExpectedOwners))
	}
	for _, owner := range observed.WASM.Inspection.Incarnations {
		choices := selected[owner.Handle]
		if len(choices) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		for _, pick := range []struct {
			Name     string
			Boundary model.WASMInspectionBoundary
		}{{"first", choices[0]}, {"last", choices[len(choices)-1]}} {
			name := fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d-%s", owner.Handle.Node, owner.Handle.Incarnation, pick.Name)
			request := model.WASMInspectionRequest{Target: owner.Handle, Stop: model.WASMInspectionStop{Kind: "choice", Value: pick.Boundary.Decision}, Dumps: []string{"stacks", "heap"}}
			resolved, err := simulation.ResolveRetainedInspection(payload, request)
			must(err)
			inspectDir := filepath.Join(input.Output, "inspect-"+name)
			must(os.Mkdir(inspectDir, 0700))
			result, err := simulation.InspectRetained(ctx, payload, retainedModule, inspectDir, helper, resolved, "")
			must(err)
			if result.Termination != "inspected_prefix" {
				panic(result.Termination)
			}
			output, err := wasi.DecodeDebugOutput(result.DebugOutput)
			must(err)
			output.SetTarget(string(owner.Handle.Node), owner.Handle.Incarnation)
			must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(input.Output, name+".heap.pprof"), output.HeapProfile, 0600))
			output.HeapProfile = nil
			save(filepath.Join(input.Output, name+".debug.json"), output)
			save(filepath.Join(input.Output, name+".resolved.json"), resolved)
			must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(input.Output, name+".inspection.json"), result.InspectionMetadata, 0600))
		}
	}
	target := model.NodeHandle{Node: "a", Incarnation: 2}
	if len(selected[target]) == 0 {
		target = model.NodeHandle{Node: "a", Incarnation: 1}
	}
	choices := selected[target]
	for _, mode := range []string{"scan", "bisect"} {
		request := simulation.WASMInspectionSearchRequest{Target: target, Cluster: true, Check: "fixture.before_three", First: 0, Last: choices[len(choices)-1].Decision, Mode: mode, AttemptBudget: 256, WallTime: 60 * time.Second}
		search, err := simulation.SearchWASMInspection(ctx, observed.WASM, request, func(attemptCtx context.Context, resolved model.WASMInspectionResolution, check string) (simulation.WASMInspectionEvaluation, error) {
			directory, err := os.MkdirTemp(input.Output, "search-"+mode+"-")
			if err != nil {
				return simulation.WASMInspectionEvaluation{}, err
			}
			result, err := simulation.InspectRetained(attemptCtx, payload, retainedModule, directory, helper, resolved, check)
			if err != nil {
				return simulation.WASMInspectionEvaluation{}, err
			}
			output, err := wasi.DecodeDebugOutput(result.DebugOutput)
			if err != nil {
				return simulation.WASMInspectionEvaluation{}, err
			}
			if len(output.Checks) != 1 {
				return simulation.WASMInspectionEvaluation{}, fmt.Errorf("expected exactly one invariant result")
			}
			status := output.Checks[0].Status
			outcome := "error"
			if status == "true" {
				outcome = "pass"
			}
			if status == "false" {
				outcome = "fail"
			}
			return simulation.WASMInspectionEvaluation{Outcome: outcome, PrefixVerified: true, Detail: status}, nil
		})
		must(err)
		if search.Status != "first_failure" || search.FirstFailure == nil {
			panic("registered invariant search must find first failure")
		}
		save(filepath.Join(input.Output, fmt.Sprintf("%s-%d-%s.search.json", target.Node, target.Incarnation, mode)), search)
	}
	fmt.Printf("owners=%d boundaries=%d\n", len(selected), len(observed.WASM.Inspection.Boundaries))
}
